name: Squeeze breakout
idea: A signal when a volatility squeeze ends with a close beyond the bands (or the TTM squeeze fires with momentum on that side); the idea has ended when the closes stay back inside the bands for a set number of bars.

params.label: The squeeze
params.help: Which squeeze the break comes out of: the narrowest Bollinger band width of the lookback, or the Bollinger bands inside the Keltner channel (TTM).
choice_labels: The bands inside the Keltner channel (TTM)

params.label: Squeeze lookback (bars)
params.help: For the Bollinger squeeze: the band width must be the narrowest of this many bars.

params.label: Volume expansion
params.help: The breakout bar's volume must be at least this many times the average (0 means no volume condition; indices have no volume).

params.label: Back inside for (bars)
params.help: The idea has ended when this many closes in a row are back inside the bands.
